g.text: Final artifacts on the same 20 fixed worlds · 3 coding calls per model · 1 trajectory per model

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #62666c

g.text: Each dot is one world; horizontal bars show the mean. World variation is not run-to-run uncertainty.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #272b31

g.text: Scope: code-writing researchers improve a frozen three-agent RL team; these are not conversational-agent game scores.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #272b31

g.text: Reward is not a pass rate. Public fixed worlds, one checkpoint and short tool-free pilots do not establish broad model rankings.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #272b31

g.text: The scripted control is a construction-time heuristic, not a research-model result. Invalid or incomplete runs remain unscored.
